title: Purification of Proteins from PFA Fixed Samples with Biotin Pulldown for LC-MS/MS
author: Bryan Killinger
materials: Briefly sonicate on low power to disperse tissue.
Carefully remove supernatant no to disturb beads.
Immediately place in -80 °C for long-term storage.
Fix gel in 100mL fixation solution (refer materials section) for 01:00:00 Room temperature .
Spot 1 µL of each sample onto PVDF.
Blot can now be probed with antibodies using standard protocols.

steps.title: Initial Section Washing
steps.instruction: Wash sections in DM three times for 10 minutes each.

steps.title: Protein Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract proteins from the sections using reversal buffer and PMSF.

substeps.instruction: Place sections in a 1.5mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 0.5 mL of reversal buffer.
Add 5 µL of 100 mM PMSF, mix well, and quick spin.
Heat on a block at 98 °C for 30 minutes with cap locks.

steps.title: Post-Extraction Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the sections in DM three times for 10 minutes each.

steps.title: Protein Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover the extracted proteins (S1) from the solution.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove samples from the heat block (ensure caps do not pop).
Centrifuge at 22,000 x g for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Collect the supernatant (S1).

steps.title: Protein Cleanup and Quantification
steps.instruction: Clean up the S1 extract and determine protein concentration.

substeps.instruction: Perform methanol/chloroform cleanup on 100 µL of S1.
Resuspend the resulting pellet in 100 µL 5% SDS.
Perform a BCA assay on 100 µL (using 20 µL per test).
Calculate the volume of S1 required to obtain 20 µg of protein (20 µg / concentration of S1 in µg/µL).

steps.title: Biotin Pulldown
steps.instruction: Capture biotinylated proteins using magnetic streptavidin beads.

substeps.instruction: Add the calculated volume of S1 to 10 mL TBST in a 15mL conical tube and mix well.
Add 40 µL of prepared magnetic streptavidin beads.
Place the tube on a magnetic stand for 1 minute until all beads are drawn out of solution.
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Bead Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the captured proteins to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL wash buffer, place on magnetic stand for 1 minute, and remove supernatant. Repeat this process two more times (total of 3 washes with 10 mL).
Add 1 mL of wash buffer and mix until beads are suspended.
Using a pipette with the tip cut off, transfer the suspended beads to a 1.5mL protein low-bind tube.
Place on magnetic stand for 1 minute and remove buffer.
Surface wash with MilliQ water twice.
Quick spin and remove all remaining liquid.

steps.title: Protein Elution
steps.instruction: Elute proteins from the beads for mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 µL 1X SDS-page sample buffer containing reducing agent.
Mix well, quick spin, and heat on a block at 98 °C for 10 minutes.
Mix well, quick spin, and place on magnet.
Transfer the eluent to two separate lo-bind tubes: 35 µL in one (for premass spec QC) and the remaining 45 µL in another (for mass spec). Discard the beads.

steps.title: SDS-PAGE and Gel Processing
steps.instruction: Run the samples on a gel and stain for visualization.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a Bis-Tris 4-12% wedge gel (15 well).
Load 5 µL of MW standard in one side of the gel.
Load exactly 40 µL of samples into every other well to prevent cross-contamination.
Fill empty wells with 40 µL 1X loading buffer.
Run the gel at 150V for a few minutes until the sample has completely entered the gel.
Remove the gel and wash in several changes of MilliQ water until it swells to original size.
Place in 100 mL colloidal Coomassie blue stain solution, cover loosely, and microwave until it just starts to boil.
Incubate in the heated stain solution for 8 minutes.
Wash several times with MilliQ water (approximately 2 hours) until the background is clear.

steps.title: Sample Recovery for MS
steps.instruction: Excise the protein bands and prepare for submission.

substeps.instruction: Using a clean razor, excise the entire sample from the gel.
Place each sample into a clean 1.5mL tube and add 500 µL of MilliQ water.
Store samples at 4 °C until submission to the mass spec core.

steps.title: Capture Concentration Estimation
steps.instruction: Estimate the amount of captured protein to prevent MS overloading.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a gel as described in the SDS-PAGE steps.
Load 20 µL of the QC aliquot into wells and load 2 µg BSA into one well.
Run the gel at 150V for approximately 45 minutes or until the dye reaches the end.
Stain with Coomassie as previously described.
Image on Odyssey using NIR and forward the image to the NW mass spectrometry core.

steps.title: PVDF Membrane Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare and activate the PVDF membrane for blotting.

substeps.instruction: Cut PVDF membrane into a ~1X3 inch piece.
Activate PVDF in 100% methanol for 30 seconds.
Just prior to blotting, place hydrated PVDF on a Wypall and pat dry.
Place on a new dry Wypall and allow to dry completely (approx. 1 hour or overnight).
Reactivate spotted PVDF as described above and equilibrate in dH20.
